info.title: Sunset Rollercoaster API
info.description: Read-only REST API for Taipower electricity data, Taiwan and international fuel prices, exchange rates, live fire department dispatch cases, invoice draws, and reservoir records.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: ISO 4217 base currency, case-insensitive (for example, `USD`).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Exact local date in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive local date lower bound in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored when `date` is set.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive local date upper bound in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored when `date` is set.

200.description: List exchange rate snapshots, newest first
Rates with original observed_at; refreshed on demand after 180 seconds. While refreshing, serves the last snapshot if under 10 minutes old.

502.description: No usable snapshot and the source failed or did not supply one within 5 seconds.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: County code from `/fire-dispatch/counties` (for example, `tainan`).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Exact local date of the case's `first_seen_at` in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive local date lower bound on the case's `first_seen_at` in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored when `date` is set.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive local date upper bound on the case's `first_seen_at` in Asia/Taipei (YYYY-MM-DD). Ignored when `date` is set.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 time: only cases with a state added or updated at or after it
(`last_seen_at >= since`), oldest `last_seen_at` first. Without `date`, `start`, `end`,
or `since`, only cases first seen in the last 24 hours are listed.

200.description: Stored records merged into cases, newest first_seen_at first (oldest last_seen_at first with `since`). Most counties publish no case number, so records sharing county, receive time, location, and category count as one case (simultaneous dispatches of several stations included); Tainan and New Taipei use their case numbers.
Supported counties and the case list each is read from
Live cases grouped by county, fetched concurrently and cached 60 seconds per county. A county whose source failed has `error` set and no cases.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 time (for example, `2026-11-27T12:00:00Z`): only records added or updated at
or after it (`last_seen_at >= since`), oldest `last_seen_at` first. Inclusive, so pass the
largest `last_seen_at` already received and drop repeats by `id`.

quote.description: ISO 4217 currency the rate is expressed in; currently always `TWD`.

rate.description: Amount of `quote` for one unit of `base`, from Google Finance.

FireDispatchCase.description: One live case from a county fire department's public case list.

case_id.description: Source case number, when published (Tainan, New Taipei).

category.description: Case category, joined as `案類-案別` when the source splits them (for example, `緊急救護-車禍`).

location.description: Incident location as published; ambulance cases are often truncated to the district.

received_at.description: When the dispatch center received the case; null when the source omits it (New Taipei).

status.description: Current status (執行狀況), for example `已出動`, when published.

unit.description: Dispatched station or vehicles (派遣分隊), when published.

FireDispatchCaseState.description: One stored state within a case's history.

FireDispatchCounty.description: Live cases of one county, fetched on demand and cached for 60 seconds.

cases.description: Cases received in the last 6 hours, newest first; cases without `received_at` last.

error.description: Why the source could not be read (only in `/fire-dispatch/latest`); `cases` is then empty.

fetched_at.description: When the source was read; null when the request failed.

source_url.description: Fire department case list the cases are read from.

FireDispatchRecord.description: One stored state of a case: a new record each time a case's status or unit changes.

first_seen_at.description: When the crawler first saw this state.

last_seen_at.description: When the crawler last saw this state in the live list.

FireDispatchStoredCase.description: Stored records merged into one case; current fields come from the latest-seen state.

first_seen_at.description: When the crawler first saw any state of the case.

history.description: Every state of the case, in the order first seen.

last_seen_at.description: When the crawler last saw any state of the case.

LiveExchangeRate.description: Real-time rate fetched from the Apps Script source and cached in memory.

observed_at.description: When the Apps Script source read the rates.

quote.description: ISO 4217 currency the rate is expressed in; currently always `TWD`.

rate.description: Amount of `quote` for one unit of `base`, from Google Finance.

brent.description: Weekly average North Sea Brent price in USD per barrel.

dubai.description: Weekly average Dubai crude price in USD per barrel.

west_texas.description: Weekly average West Texas Intermediate price in USD per barrel.

energy_storage_load_mw.description: Storage charging load in MW; this is normally zero or negative.

ipp_lng_mw.description: Independent power producer LNG generation in MW.

category_code.description: Stable source category code such as `lng`, `coal`, or `solar`.

installed_capacity_percent.description: Category share included by Taipower on subtotal rows.

net_generation_percent.description: Category share included by Taipower on subtotal rows.

sequence.description: Row order in the source snapshot.

is_forecast.description: True for today's published estimate; false after actual data is available.

published_at.description: Publish time is present for today's forecast and absent for historical actuals.
